orders.instruction: Preserve the credited level's policy. Probe the first unsolved level online: compare frames after each keyboard action and component-center click to learn movement and interaction rules. Track visited state/action pairs, avoid repeated failures, and plan toward observed goal conditions.

Adapt lp85's credited click policy to this untried game. Relearn component roles and legal click targets from before/after frames; do not copy coordinates. Probe each distinct component, retain clicks that advance the observed goal, and avoid repeating unchanged state/target pairs.

Adapt m0r0's credited perception and action-selection logic to this untried game. Probe keyboard actions and component-center clicks separately to identify their effects, then learn which sequence advances the goal. Rebuild game-specific rules and coordinates; use only sandbox-allowed operations.

summary: Fill all three slots: extend a credited solver and test two untried games through donor adaptation. Stop scheduling at 85% maker budget; judge success by levels beating all controls.
